Unprocessable.description: VALIDATION_ERROR and the other 422 codes of TRD 05 §4.7

id.description: stable across rebuilds (upsert key epoch_id + session_id)

robust_spread.description: 0 is possible only for a non-composite feature with floor 0 (TRD 08 BSC-035, TRD 20 baselines_spread_ck)

quarantined_days.description: days with a quarantined record and no usable or set-aside record

set_aside_days.description: days with a set-aside record and no usable record

detail.description: pipeline reason text or progress, e.g. "16 of 16"

resident_value.description: median of the resident's usable check-ins so far

detail.description: v0.2 text without the leading code (TRD 09 §4.9, TRD 24 D-114); the UI renders '<code>: <detail>'

from.description: first local date; not before the resident's enrolled_on in ResidentDetail

in_use_until.description: last local day of the device's last assignment; null while it has a current assignment

Explanation.description: Structured facts only; wording is rendered by the frontend (OQ-12).

expected.description: sum over residents of enrolled days in period

set_aside_multi_reason.description: set-aside sessions with more than one reason

pipeline_run_id.description: null when no first-arrival record was accepted

IngestRecord.description:
Schema v0.1; property order equals the SRC-05 CSV header. Feature names are placeholders
(OQ-03) mapped by configuration.

row_number.description: 1-based position in the batch (CSV excludes header)

as_of.description: as-of of the latest succeeded pipeline run

needs_attention.description: needs_attention true and status not alarm_on

code.description: ingest endpoints: TRD 10 ING-023 field codes; other endpoints: Pydantic error type

ZValues.description: The 7 unsigned z values of the scored features (contract §6 order).

info.description: EchoWell research system API. Detects a change in a resident's voice measurements relative to their own frozen baseline; a prompt to check in, not a diagnosis. No audio endpoints exist.
info.title: EchoWell API

200.description: Baselines (JSON) or CSV export when Accept is text/csv

file.description: UTF-8 CSV with the SRC-05 header, max 5 MB

200.description: Scored sessions (JSON) or CSV export when Accept is text/csv (researcher, admin)

servers.description: relative to the deployed Railway API origin (staging, production)
